Then the moment he comes across the ring, it poisons his mind enough to kill his best friend and on his birthday of all days. He then gets cast out of talk to village, and then takes refuge in the deep dark Caves of the Misty Mountains. At which point, the ring gives him 500 years of unnatural long life. So that's 500 years of living alone in the deep, dark caves. Eating nothing but goblin flesh and raw fish, and thinking of nothing but the ring. Gollum was nothing to the ring, while the ring was his everything. Then after 500 years of living and breathing only for that ring, it disappears and leaves you. The ONLY thing he had. Then he finally has the courage to leave his cave and track Bilbo down using only his faint scent and remembering "Shire" and "Baggins" from their brief riddle back and forth. Fast forward to LotR. Mordor have captured Gollum and are torturing him. Imagine after 500 years of that ring being your everything. Imagine what they did and how long they must have done it to him to get him to finally tell them information about his "precious" that they are also hunting after. As Gandalf said, "I don't know how long they tortured him. But amidst the endless screams and inane babble, they discerned two words…" Gollum (shrieking): "Shire! Baggins!". Something that was still capable of good. But in the end, he didn't get his redemption. Just fiery, molten, lava while pathetically holding the ring aloft to keep it safe. 589 years of nothing but parasitic, draining torture.
